capabilities: Draw a note as a mind map, tree table or outline
Navigate, search and focus heading nodes
Edit, add, delete and drag headings and sections
Run commands to go to, copy, align, insert and move headings
Select all content under a heading
extras: Mobile defaults to the outline layout; drag and drop needs a mouse or pen. If the file changes elsewhere while editing a node, the edit is not written back and the text is copied to the clipboard. View state can be remembered for up to 200 files.
problem: Restructuring headings in Obsidian means scrolling, cutting and pasting, and manually correcting heading levels.
summary: Heading navigator and structural view that draws a note as a mind map, tree table or outline and edits headings in place.
